sw.L: Lakini mtakapomwona chukizo la uharibifu amesimama mahali asipopaswa (msomaji na aelewe), basi walio katika Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani; \v 15 aliye juu ya dari asishuke wala asiingie kuchukua kitu chochote nyumbani mwake, \v 16 na aliye shambani asirudi nyuma kuchukua joho lake.
sw.B: Lakini mtakapomwona 'chukizo linaloleta maangamizi' amesimama mahali ambapo hana haki ya kuwa (msomaji na azingatie), basi wale walio Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani. \v 15 Aliye juu ya paa asishuke kuingia nyumbani kuchukua kitu chochote. \v 16 Aliye shambani asirudi kuchukua koti lake.
sw.R: Siku moja mtamwona 'chukizo la kutisha linaloharibu' amesimama mahali asipopaswa kusimama. (Msomaji, fikiri kwa makini maana ya jambo hili.) Hilo litakapotokea, watu walio Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani. \v 15 Mtu akiwa juu ya paa la nyumba, asishuke wala asiingie ndani kuchukua kitu chochote. \v 16 Mtu akiwa anafanya kazi shambani, asirudi nyumbani kuchukua koti lake.

pt.L: Mas, quando vocês virem a abominação da desolação de pé onde ele não deve [estar] (quem lê, entenda), então os que [estiverem] na Judeia fujam para os montes; \v 15 quem [estiver] no terraço não desça nem entre para tirar alguma coisa da sua casa, \v 16 e quem [estiver] no campo não volte para trás para pegar o seu manto.
pt.B: Mas, quando vocês virem a abominação que traz a ruína de pé onde ele não tem o direito de estar (quem lê, preste atenção), então os que estiverem na Judeia devem fugir para os montes. \v 15 Quem estiver no terraço não deve descer nem entrar em casa para buscar alguma coisa. \v 16 Quem estiver no campo não deve voltar para pegar o manto.
pt.R: Um dia vocês vão ver 'a coisa horrível que traz a ruína' de pé onde ele não deveria estar. (Leitor, pense bem no que isso quer dizer.) Quando isso acontecer, as pessoas que estiverem na Judeia devem fugir para os montes. \v 15 Se alguém estiver no terraço da casa, não deve descer nem entrar para pegar nada. \v 16 Se alguém estiver trabalhando no campo, não deve voltar para pegar a capa.

decisions.choice: the abomination of desolation: the phrase from Daniel 9:27, 11:31 and 12:11
decisions.reason: In Daniel it is a detestable thing set up in God's sanctuary that leaves it desolate. In 167 BC the Syrian king Antiochus IV set up a pagan altar on the temple altar, and 1 Maccabees 1:54 uses the same phrase for it. Jesus says something like it will happen again.

decisions.choice: standing: a masculine participle, pointing to a person
alternatives: it standing: a thing, matching the noun
decisions.reason: The noun "abomination" is neuter, but "standing" is masculine. That suggests a person: someone who stands where only God belongs. Mark does not say who.

decisions.choice: where he must not: in the holy place, the temple
decisions.reason: Daniel speaks of the sanctuary, and Matthew 24:15 says "in the holy place". Mark keeps the phrase veiled.

decisions.choice: let the one reading understand: an aside to the reader
alternatives: Jesus telling his hearers to read Daniel carefully
decisions.reason: The words speak of reading, not hearing, so they are most likely Mark's own words to those who read his book aloud or to themselves. They urge the reader to see what the veiled phrase means.

decisions.choice: the housetop, the cloak: flat roofs used as living space, and the outer garment laid aside for work
decisions.reason: Houses had flat roofs reached by an outside stair, so one could leave without going in. A worker in the field would lay the outer cloak aside. The danger will be so sudden that there is no time even for these.

decisions.choice: their or his (L); anyone ... a cloak (B); someone ... they (R)
alternatives: let him ... his house ... his cloak
decisions.reason: The commands are general and apply to anyone. Literal offers "their" or "his" through the gender setting; Balanced and Readable use "anyone" and "they".

decisions.choice: the abomination that brings ruin (B); the horrible thing that destroys (R); let the reader take note (B); Reader, think carefully about what this means (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Daniel's phrase as it is. Balanced and Readable say what it means. All levels keep Mark's aside in parentheses.

decisions.choice: "sự ghê tởm của sự hoang tàn" (L); "vật ghê tởm gây ra cảnh hoang tàn" (B); "vật kinh khủng gây ra sự tàn phá" (R); "hắn" for the one standing
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Daniel's two nouns; Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means. The Greek participle is masculine and points to a person (see the footnoted meaning decision), so the one who stands there is "hắn", a pronoun for a hostile person, where "nó" would make him a thing.

decisions.choice: "nhà mình", "áo choàng mình", "ai", with no gender span
alternatives: gender setting spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người", "ai" and the reflexive "mình" already include men and women (style guide section 7), so the English gender spans have no Vietnamese counterpart here or in 13:34.

decisions.choice: "황폐함의 가증한 것" (L); "멸망을 가져오는 가증한 것" (B); "모든 것을 망가뜨리는 끔찍한 것" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek genitive as Daniel's phrase; Balanced says what the desolation does in natural Korean; Readable uses plain words. "가증한" keeps the sense of something detestable to God.

decisions.choice: "자기가 서서는 안 될 곳에" (L, B)
alternatives: "서서는 안 될 곳에" with no subject
decisions.reason: The Greek participle is masculine, pointing to a person (meaning decision). Korean has no grammatical gender, so Literal and Balanced add "자기가", which suits a person, while the noun "가증한 것" stays as Daniel's word.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "자기 집", "자기 겉옷" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" (one's own) is not gendered, so the English span "their/his" has nothing to change in Korean (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: se tenant là où il ne doit pas [se tenir] (L); dressée là où il n’a pas le droit d’être (B); debout là où il ne devrait pas être (R)
alternatives: là où il ne faut pas
decisions.reason: French "abomination" is feminine, so French cannot show the masculine participle of the Greek (meaning decision m2, footnoted) by agreement without a grammatical error. The masculine "il" in the clause that follows keeps the hint of a person, as the English "he" does; the footnote gives the rest.

decisions.choice: celui qui ... sa maison, son manteau (L, B); quelqu’un ... qu’il (R); no gender setting
alternatives: a gender setting span, as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: French "celui qui" and "quelqu’un" already mean anyone, and the possessive "sa", "son" agrees with the thing owned, not the owner, so French needs no gender setting where the English Literal has "their|his" (French brief, section 7).

decisions.choice: de pie donde él no debe
decisions.reason: Mark's participle is masculine although "abominación" is feminine, which points to a person (meaning decision m2). "De pie" does not change for gender, and the plain "él" keeps the hint of a person as the English "he" does; it is not a pronoun for God and takes no setting.

decisions.choice: el que, alguien, su: no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "su casa" and "su manto" do not show the owner's sex, so none of the English gender spans is needed.

decisions.choice: azotea; manto (L, B), capa (R)
decisions.reason: "Azotea" is the flat roof used as living space (meaning decision m5); Readable uses the everyday "capa" for the outer garment.

decisions.choice: personal agreement: mtakapomwona ... amesimama mahali asipopaswa
alternatives: mtakapoliona ... likiwa limesimama mahali lisipopaswa (agreement with the noun 'chukizo')
decisions.reason: 'Chukizo' is a class 5 noun and would normally take 'li-' agreement (it is standing). The Greek participle is masculine and points to a person (meaning decision, with footnote), so every level uses the personal object and subject markers 'mw-' and 'a-', as Swahili does for a noun that names a living being (compare 'Neno alikuwa', John 1:1). A native reviewer should check that this reads naturally.

decisions.choice: Uyahudi; joho (L), koti (B, R)
decisions.reason: 'Uyahudi' is the region, as in Swahili John (7:3; 11:7) and Mark 1:5, 3:7 and 10:1. The outer garment is 'joho' at Literal and the everyday 'koti' at Balanced and Readable, as the English says cloak and coat.

decisions.choice: ele, after a feminine noun
decisions.reason: "Abominação" and "coisa" are feminine, so "ele" breaks the agreement just as the Greek masculine participle does, and points to a person (m2). Dropping the pronoun would lose the hint; "ela" would make it a thing.

decisions.choice: da sua casa, o seu manto, with no gender setting
alternatives: {{gender:da casa dela ou dele|da casa dele}}
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 24:17-18: "seu" and "sua" agree with the thing owned, not the owner, so after "quem" they already mean anyone's. The English needs a setting here; Portuguese does not.

decisions.choice: o terraço
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as in Matthew 24:17: the flat roof used as living space (m5) is a "terraço"; a Brazilian "telhado" is a sloping tiled roof no one stands on.

source.text: οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις.

records.literal_gloss: Woe then to those in womb having and to those nursing in those days.

en.L: And woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing in those days!
en.B: How terrible it will be in those days for women who are expecting a child or nursing a baby!
en.R: Those days will be very hard for women who are going to have a baby, and for mothers who are feeding babies.

vi.L: Nhưng khốn cho những người đang mang thai và những người đang cho con bú trong những ngày ấy!
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, thật khốn khổ cho những phụ nữ đang mang thai hoặc đang cho con bú!
vi.R: Những ngày ấy sẽ rất khổ cho những phụ nữ sắp sinh con và những người mẹ đang cho con bú.

ko.L: 그러나 그 날들에는 아이를 밴 여자들과 젖을 먹이는 여자들에게 화가 있다!
ko.B: 그 날에는 아이를 밴 여자들과 젖먹이를 둔 여자들이 얼마나 괴롭겠느냐!
ko.R: 그때가 되면 곧 아기를 낳을 여자들과 아기에게 젖을 먹이는 엄마들은 아주 힘들 것이다.

es.L: ¡Y ay de las que estén embarazadas y de las que estén amamantando en aquellos días!
es.B: ¡Qué terrible será en aquellos días para las mujeres que estén embarazadas o que estén amamantando!
es.R: Esos días serán muy duros para las mujeres que estén esperando un bebé y para las madres que estén dando el pecho a sus hijos.

fr.L: Mais malheur à celles qui portent [un enfant] dans [leur] ventre et à celles qui allaitent en ces jours-là !
fr.B: Quel malheur, en ces jours-là, pour les femmes qui attendent un enfant ou qui allaitent !
fr.R: Ces jours-là seront très durs pour les femmes qui vont avoir un bébé, et pour les mamans qui nourrissent leur bébé au sein.

sw.L: Na ole wao wenye mimba na wanaonyonyesha katika siku hizo!
sw.B: Itakuwa vibaya mno siku hizo kwa wanawake wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha!
sw.R: Siku hizo zitakuwa ngumu sana kwa wanawake walio na mimba, na kwa akina mama wanaonyonyesha watoto wachanga.

pt.L: E ai das que estiverem grávidas e das que estiverem amamentando naqueles dias!
pt.B: Como vai ser terrível naqueles dias para as mulheres que estiverem grávidas ou amamentando!
pt.R: Aqueles dias vão ser muito difíceis para as mulheres grávidas e para as mães que estiverem amamentando.

decisions.choice: having in the womb: pregnant
decisions.reason: "To have in the womb" is the ordinary Greek way of saying a woman is pregnant.

decisions.choice: woe: a cry of grief and pity
decisions.reason: Here "woe" is not a curse on these women. It grieves for them, because they will find it hardest to flee.

decisions.choice: How terrible it will be (B); will be very hard (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express the cry of pity in current English.

decisions.choice: "화가 있다" (L); "얼마나 괴롭겠느냐" (B); "아주 힘들 것이다" (R) for ouai
decisions.reason: Woe here is a cry of grief and pity (meaning decision). Literal keeps the traditional "화가 있다" in a modern ending, not the archaic "화로다"; Balanced and Readable say the pity in ordinary words.

source.text: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται χειμῶνος·

records.literal_gloss: Pray then that not it happen in winter.

en.L: And pray that it may not happen in winter.
en.B: Pray that this does not come in winter.
en.R: Pray that it will not happen in the winter.

vi.L: Và hãy cầu nguyện để điều đó đừng xảy ra vào mùa đông.
vi.B: Hãy cầu nguyện để việc ấy đừng xảy đến vào mùa đông.
vi.R: Hãy cầu nguyện để việc đó không xảy ra vào mùa đông.

ko.L: 그리고 그 일이 겨울에 일어나지 않도록 기도하여라.
ko.B: 이 일이 겨울에 닥치지 않도록 기도하여라.
ko.R: 그 일이 추운 겨울에 일어나지 않게 해 달라고 기도하여라.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:oren|orad}} para que no suceda en invierno.
es.B: {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que esto no ocurra en invierno.
es.R: {{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que no suceda en el invierno.

fr.L: Or priez afin que cela n’arrive pas en hiver.
fr.B: Priez pour que cela ne survienne pas en hiver.
fr.R: Priez pour que cela n’arrive pas pendant l’hiver.

sw.L: Lakini ombeni ili [jambo hili] lisitokee wakati wa baridi.
sw.B: Ombeni jambo hili lisitokee wakati wa majira ya baridi.
sw.R: Ombeni kwamba jambo hili lisitokee wakati wa baridi na mvua.

pt.L: E orem para que não aconteça no inverno.
pt.B: Orem para que isso não venha no inverno.
pt.R: Orem para que isso não aconteça no inverno.

decisions.choice: winter: the cold, rainy season
decisions.reason: In Judea winter is the rainy season. Streams in the valleys run high and roads turn to mud, so flight on foot would be hard.

decisions.choice: it: the time of flight and trouble just described
decisions.reason: There is no stated subject. The sense is that the time of flight should not fall in winter.

decisions.choice: that it not happen in winter: the SBLGNT reading
alternatives: that your flight not happen in winter
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "your flight", as in Matthew 24:20, making the subject clear. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: wakati wa baridi (L); majira ya baridi (B); wakati wa baridi na mvua (R)
decisions.reason: Most Swahili readers know no winter. 'Majira ya baridi' is the usual name for the cold season; Readable adds the rains because in Judea that season was both cold and wet (meaning decision on winter), when roads were hard to travel. Literal brackets 'jambo hili', the subject Swahili needs for 'it'.

source.text: ἔσονται γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι θλῖψις οἵα οὐ γέγονεν τοιαύτη ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ἣν ἔκτισεν ὁ θεὸς ἕως τοῦ νῦν καὶ οὐ μὴ γένηται.

records.literal_gloss: Will be for the days those tribulation such as not has happened such from beginning of creation which created God until the now and no not will happen.

en.L: For those days will be tribulation such as has not happened from [the] beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will.
en.B: For those days will bring distress unlike any there has been from the beginning, when God created the world, until now, or ever will be again.
en.R: That will be a time of terrible trouble. Nothing like it has happened since God made the world, and nothing like it will ever happen again.

vi.L: Vì những ngày ấy sẽ là hoạn nạn, [một hoạn nạn] như chưa từng có từ ban đầu của sự sáng tạo mà Đức Chúa Trời đã sáng tạo cho đến bây giờ, và sẽ không bao giờ có nữa.
vi.B: Vì những ngày ấy sẽ có cơn hoạn nạn chưa từng có từ buổi đầu, khi Đức Chúa Trời sáng tạo thế giới, cho đến nay, và về sau cũng sẽ không bao giờ có nữa.
vi.R: Đó sẽ là một thời kỳ vô cùng khốn khổ. Từ khi Đức Chúa Trời dựng nên thế giới đến nay, chưa từng có điều gì như vậy, và về sau cũng sẽ không bao giờ có nữa.

ko.L: 그 날들이, 하나님께서 창조하신 창조의 처음부터 지금까지 없었고 앞으로도 결코 없을 그런 환난이 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 날들에는 큰 고난이 닥칠 것이다. 하나님께서 세상을 창조하신 처음부터 지금까지 그런 고난은 없었고, 앞으로도 다시는 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때는 아주 끔찍한 고통의 때가 될 것이다. 하나님께서 세상을 만드신 뒤로 그런 일은 한 번도 없었고, 앞으로도 결코 없을 것이다.

es.L: Porque aquellos días serán tribulación tal como no ha habido desde [el] principio de la creación que creó Dios hasta ahora, ni habrá jamás.
es.B: Porque esos días traerán una angustia como no la ha habido desde el principio, cuando Dios creó el mundo, hasta ahora, ni la habrá nunca más.
es.R: Será un tiempo de sufrimiento terrible. Nunca ha pasado nada igual desde que Dios hizo el mundo, y nunca volverá a pasar nada igual.

fr.L: Car ces jours-là seront une tribulation telle qu’il n’y en a pas eu de pareille depuis [le] commencement de la création que Dieu a créée jusqu’à maintenant, et qu’il n’y en aura jamais.
fr.B: Car ces jours-là apporteront une détresse comme il n’y en a jamais eu depuis le commencement, quand Dieu a créé le monde, jusqu’à maintenant, et comme il n’y en aura plus jamais.
fr.R: Ce sera un temps de terribles malheurs. Rien de pareil n’est arrivé depuis que Dieu a créé le monde, et rien de pareil n’arrivera plus jamais.

sw.L: Kwa maana siku hizo zitakuwa dhiki ambayo haijatokea mfano wake tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji ambao Mungu aliumba hadi sasa, wala haitatokea kamwe.
sw.B: Kwa maana siku hizo zitaleta dhiki ambayo haijapata kutokea tangu mwanzo, Mungu alipoumba ulimwengu, hadi sasa, wala haitatokea tena kamwe.
sw.R: Huo utakuwa wakati wa taabu kubwa sana. Hakuna taabu kama hiyo iliyowahi kutokea tangu Mungu alipoumba ulimwengu, na hakuna itakayotokea tena kamwe.

pt.L: Pois aqueles dias serão uma tribulação tal como não houve desde [o] princípio da criação que Deus criou até agora, nem jamais haverá.
pt.B: Pois aqueles dias trarão uma aflição como nunca houve desde o princípio, quando Deus criou o mundo, até agora, nem jamais haverá.
pt.R: Vai ser um tempo de sofrimento terrível. Nada igual aconteceu desde que Deus fez o mundo, e nada igual vai acontecer de novo.

decisions.choice: tribulation such as has not happened: in the words of Daniel 12:1
decisions.reason: Daniel 12:1 speaks of a time of distress such as has never been since there was a nation until that time. Jesus widens it to the whole of creation.

decisions.choice: those days will be tribulation: those days will be a time of great distress
decisions.reason: The days are described as being the distress itself, a strong way of saying what will fill them.

decisions.choice: the creation which God created: a doubled phrase that stresses the whole span of time
decisions.reason: Saying the same thing twice is a Hebrew way of adding weight: since the very beginning of everything God made.

decisions.choice: never will: a double negative
decisions.reason: The strong denial again: there will never be another time like it.

decisions.choice: tribulation (L); distress (B); terrible trouble (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the long-used word. Balanced and Readable use everyday words for great suffering and pressure.

decisions.choice: "hoạn nạn" (L, B); "thời kỳ vô cùng khốn khổ" (R), also in 13:24
decisions.reason: "Hoạn nạn" is the established word for this distress; Readable says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "환난" (L); "고난" (B); "끔찍한 고통" (R) for thlipsis, also at 13:24
decisions.reason: "환난" is the established church word, kept at Literal as in the Korean John 16:33 and Mark 4:17; Balanced and Readable use words a reader hears every day.

decisions.choice: tribulación (L); angustia (B); sufrimiento terrible (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word of Daniel 12:1 (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable use everyday words. The same choice returns in 13:24.

decisions.choice: dhiki (L, B); taabu kubwa (R)
decisions.reason: 'Dhiki' is great distress pressing on people, the word for tribulation in the letters (Colossians 1:24); 'mateso' would narrow it to suffering inflicted by others. Readable says 'taabu kubwa', as the English Readable says 'terrible trouble'. The same words in 13:24.

decisions.choice: tribulação (L); aflição (B); sofrimento terrível (R)
decisions.reason: For the chapter (13:19, 24), as in Matthew 24:21, 29: Literal keeps the long-used "tribulação"; Balanced and Readable use everyday words.

source.text: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολόβωσεν κύριος τὰς ἡμέρας, οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ.

records.literal_gloss: And if not had shortened Lord the days, not would have been saved any flesh.

en.L: And if [the] Lord had not shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved.
en.B: If the Lord had not cut those days short, no one at all would survive.
en.R: If the Lord had not made that time shorter, no one would live through it.

vi.L: Và nếu Chúa đã không rút ngắn những ngày ấy, thì không một xác thịt nào được cứu.
vi.B: Nếu Chúa không rút ngắn những ngày ấy, thì chẳng ai sống sót được.
vi.R: Nếu Chúa không làm cho thời gian ấy ngắn lại, thì không ai có thể sống sót qua thời gian đó.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 주님께서 그 날들을 줄이지 않으셨다면, 어떤 육체도 구원받지 못했을 것이다.
ko.B: 주님께서 그 날들을 줄여 주지 않으셨다면, 살아남을 사람이 하나도 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 주님께서 그 기간을 짧게 해 주지 않으셨다면, 아무도 그때를 견디고 살아남지 못할 것이다.

es.L: Y si [el] Señor no hubiera acortado los días, no se habría salvado ninguna carne.
es.B: Si el Señor no hubiera acortado esos días, nadie sobreviviría.
es.R: Si el Señor no hubiera hecho más corto ese tiempo, nadie quedaría con vida.

fr.L: Et si [le] Seigneur n’avait pas abrégé les jours, aucune chair n’aurait été sauvée.
fr.B: Si le Seigneur n’avait pas raccourci ces jours, personne ne survivrait.
fr.R: Si le Seigneur n’avait pas rendu ce temps plus court, personne n’en sortirait vivant.

sw.L: Na kama Bwana asingefupisha siku hizo, hakuna mwili wowote ungeokolewa.
sw.B: Kama Bwana asingezifupisha siku hizo, hakuna mtu hata mmoja angenusurika.
sw.R: Kama Bwana asingeufupisha wakati huo, hakuna mtu ambaye angebaki hai.

pt.L: E, se [o] Senhor não tivesse abreviado os dias, nenhuma carne teria sido salva.
pt.B: Se o Senhor não tivesse encurtado aqueles dias, ninguém sobreviveria.
pt.R: Se o Senhor não tivesse encurtado aquele tempo, ninguém ficaria vivo.

decisions.choice: Lord: God
decisions.reason: Here "Lord" means God, as the next sentence shows: the one who chose the elect.

decisions.choice: any flesh: any human being
decisions.reason: "Flesh" stands for living people. "No flesh" means no one.

decisions.choice: be saved: survive, come through alive
decisions.reason: Here the word speaks of living through the distress, not of salvation at the end as in 13:13.

decisions.choice: had shortened: the past tense speaks of a decision God has already made
decisions.reason: The days have not yet come, but God has already decided to cut them short.

decisions.choice: survive (B); live through it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show that physical survival is meant.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for the Lord, God; "không một xác thịt nào" (L)
decisions.reason: "Chúa" is the word for the Lord at every level, as in John; the meaning decision says God is meant. Literal keeps the Greek picture "flesh" for a human being; Balanced and Readable say "no one".

decisions.choice: "주님" for kyrios meaning God
decisions.reason: The Lord here is God (meaning decision); "주님께서" keeps Jesus' word and its honour, as the Korean Colossians does for the Lord.

decisions.choice: "어떤 육체도" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "flesh" for a human being; Balanced and Readable say "no one".

source.text: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἐκολόβωσεν τὰς ἡμέρας.

records.literal_gloss: But because of the elect whom he chose he shortened the days.

en.L: But because of the elect, whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shortened the days.
en.B: But because of the chosen, those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has cut the days short.
en.R: But God has chosen people to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own. For their sake {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made that time shorter.

vi.L: Nhưng vì cớ những người được chọn, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rút ngắn những ngày ấy.
vi.B: Nhưng vì những người được chọn, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn cho chính mình, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rút ngắn những ngày ấy.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn một dân làm của riêng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho thời gian ấy ngắn lại.

ko.L: 그러나 그분이 택하신 택함 받은 사람들 때문에, 그 날들을 줄이셨다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님께서는 자기를 위하여 택하신 사람들 때문에 그 날들을 줄여 주셨다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 사람들을 택하셔서 자기 백성으로 삼으셨다. 그들을 위하여 하나님께서 그 기간을 짧게 해 주셨다.

es.L: Pero por causa de los elegidos, a quienes escogió, acortó los días.
es.B: Pero, por causa de los elegidos, los que escogió para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}, ha acortado esos días.
es.R: Pero Dios ha elegido a un pueblo para que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenezca. Por amor a ellos, ha hecho más corto ese tiempo.

fr.L: Mais à cause des élus, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a abrégé les jours.
fr.B: Mais à cause des élus, ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est choisis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a raccourci ces jours.
fr.R: Mais Dieu a choisi des gens pour qu’ils soient à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. À cause d’eux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu ce temps plus court.

sw.L: Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, aliowachagua, alizifupisha siku hizo.
sw.B: Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, wale aliowachagua kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, amezifupisha siku hizo.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu amewachagua watu wawe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kwa ajili yao, ameufupisha wakati huo.

pt.L: Mas, por causa dos eleitos, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abreviou os dias.
pt.B: Mas, por causa dos escolhidos, aqueles que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu para {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} encurtou os dias.
pt.R: Mas Deus escolheu pessoas para pertencerem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Por causa delas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} encurtou aquele tempo.

decisions.choice: the elect: the people God has chosen, his people
decisions.reason: In the Scriptures the chosen are God's people. Here they are those who belong to God through Jesus (13:22, 27).

decisions.choice: chose: a middle form, chose for himself
decisions.reason: The form stresses that God chose them to be his own.

decisions.choice: the elect whom he chose: a doubled phrase that stresses God's choice
decisions.reason: As in 13:19, the repeated root adds weight.

decisions.choice: God has chosen people to be his own
alternatives: because of the elect whom he chose
decisions.reason: Readable names God and says what "the elect" means.

decisions.choice: "những người được chọn" (L, B); "dân được Đức Chúa Trời chọn" (R), here and in 13:22 and 13:27
decisions.reason: A plain phrase for "the elect" that keeps the link with the verb "chose"; "tuyển dân" is a learned Sino-Vietnamese word and often means Israel alone.

decisions.choice: "택함 받은 사람들" (L, B); "하나님께서 택하신 사람들" (R) for the elect, through chapter 13; here "택하신 택함 받은 사람들" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the doubled phrase "the elect whom he chose"; "택함 받은 사람들" says plainly that God chose them. "자들" sounds old-fashioned, and "선민" is used of Israel.

decisions.choice: les élus (L, B); des gens ... à lui, ceux que Dieu a choisis (R); the same in verses 22 and 27
decisions.reason: "Les élus" is the established French word for God's chosen people and reads naturally at Balanced; Readable says plainly who they are, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}
decisions.reason: Shows the middle voice, chose for himself (meaning decision m2); the stressed "sí" refers to God and takes the setting. Spanish leaves the subject of "escogió" and "acortó" in the verb.

decisions.choice: wateule (L, B); watu aliowachagua (R)
decisions.reason: 'Wateule' (the chosen) is the word for God's elect in 1 Peter 1:1 and Colossians 3:12, so the same word is used at 13:22 and 13:27. Readable says it as a clause, with 'watu wateule wa Mungu' in 13:22 and 13:27, as the English Readable says 'God's chosen people'.

decisions.choice: os eleitos (L); os escolhidos (B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (13:20, 22, 27), as in Matthew 24: Literal keeps the long-used "eleitos"; in Brazil "eleito" now first suggests winning an election, so Balanced says "escolhidos", as the English Balanced says "the chosen".

source.text: καὶ τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ· Ἴδε ὧδε ὁ χριστός, Ἴδε ἐκεῖ, μὴ πιστεύετε·

records.literal_gloss: And then if anyone to you says, Look, here the Christ, look, there, not believe.

en.L: And then if anyone says to you, 'Look, here [is] the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}},' 'Look, there,' do not believe [it].
en.B: At that time, if anyone tells you, 'See, here is the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}!' or 'See, there he is!' do not believe it.
en.R: At that time someone may say to you, 'Look, here is the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}!' or 'Look, he is over there!' Do not believe it.

vi.L: Và bấy giờ, nếu có ai nói với các con: 'Kìa, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ở đây,' [hoặc] 'Kìa, ở đó,' thì đừng tin.
vi.B: Lúc ấy, nếu có ai bảo các con: 'Xem kìa, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ở đây!' hoặc 'Xem kìa, Đấng ấy ở đằng kia!' thì đừng tin.
vi.R: Lúc ấy, có thể có người nói với các con: 'Xem này, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ở đây!' hoặc 'Xem kìa, Đấng ấy ở đằng kia!' Đừng tin điều đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그때에 누가 너희에게 '보아라, 여기 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 [계신다]', '보아라, 저기 [계신다]' 하더라도, 믿지 마라.
ko.B: 그때에 누가 너희에게 '보아라, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여기 계신다!' 또는 '보아라, 저기 계신다!' 하고 말하더라도 믿지 마라.
ko.R: 그때 누가 너희에게 '보아라, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여기 계신다!' 하거나 '보아라, 저기 계신다!' 하고 말할지도 모른다. 그 말을 믿지 마라.

es.L: Y entonces, si alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} dice: “Mira, aquí [está] el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}”, “Mira, allí”, no [lo] {{plural_you:crean|creáis}}.
es.B: En ese tiempo, si alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} dice: “¡Mira, aquí está el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}!”, o: “¡Mira, allí está!”, no lo {{plural_you:crean|creáis}}.
es.R: En ese tiempo alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} podrá decir: “¡Mira, aquí está el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}!”, o: “¡Mira, está allí!”. No lo {{plural_you:crean|creáis}}.

fr.L: Et alors, si quelqu’un vous dit : “Voici, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} [est] ici”, “Voici, [il est] là”, ne [le] croyez pas.
fr.B: À ce moment-là, si quelqu’un vous dit : “Regardez, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est ici !” ou : “Regardez, il est là !”, ne le croyez pas.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, quelqu’un vous dira peut-être : “Regardez, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est ici !” ou : “Regardez, il est là-bas !” Ne le croyez pas.

sw.L: Na wakati huo mtu yeyote akiwaambia, 'Tazama, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} yuko hapa,' 'Tazama, kule,' msiamini.
sw.B: Wakati huo mtu akiwaambia, 'Tazameni, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} yuko hapa!' au 'Tazameni, yuko kule!' msiamini.
sw.R: Wakati huo mtu anaweza kuwaambia, 'Angalieni, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} yuko hapa!' au 'Angalieni, yuko kule!' Msiamini.

pt.L: E então, se alguém lhes disser: 'Vejam, aqui [está] o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}', 'Vejam, ali', não creiam.
pt.B: Naquele tempo, se alguém lhes disser: 'Vejam, o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} está aqui!' ou: 'Vejam, ele está ali!', não acreditem.
pt.R: Naquele tempo, alguém pode dizer a vocês: 'Olhem, o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} está aqui!' ou: 'Olhem, ele está lá!' Não acreditem nisso.

decisions.choice: the Christ: the Messiah, the anointed king God promised
decisions.reason: "Christ" is the Greek for the Hebrew title Messiah, the Anointed One. People will claim the promised king has appeared.

decisions.choice: then: in that time of distress
decisions.reason: "Then" ties the warning to the days just described.

decisions.choice: do not believe: a present command, do not go on believing such claims
alternatives: do not listen to them at all
decisions.reason: The command is plain: refuse to believe such reports, however often they come.

decisions.choice: 'Look, there' (L); 'See, there he is!' (B); 'Look, he is over there!' (R)
decisions.reason: Greek gives only "look, there". Balanced and Readable add "or" and "he is" to make the second claim a full saying.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide's span for the title with the article; "Đấng" carries the article's sense, so Vietnamese needs no separate word for it.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 [계신다]
decisions.reason: The christos span as the style guide gives it; Korean has no article, so the title needs no "the". Those who make the claim would speak of the Messiah with honour, so the verb takes the honorific; Literal brackets the verb Greek leaves out.

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek has the article and means the expected Messiah as a title (meaning decision m1), so every level writes the article outside the span, as the French brief does for "the Christ" ("Je ne suis pas le Christ", John 1:20).

decisions.choice: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}
decisions.reason: A title with the article, as in the Spanish of John 1:20, at every level. "Mira" is the interjection of the Greek, singular as there, so it takes no setting.

source.text: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πρὸς τὸ ἀποπλανᾶν εἰ δυνατὸν τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς·

records.literal_gloss: Will arise for false-christs and false-prophets and will give signs and wonders so as to mislead, if possible, the elect.

en.L: For false {{christos:christs|messiahs}} and false prophets will arise and will give signs and wonders so as to mislead, if possible, the elect.
en.B: For false {{christos:christs|messiahs}} and false prophets will rise up and do signs and wonders, so as to lead the chosen ones astray, if that could be done.
en.R: People will come who falsely claim to be {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. Others will falsely claim to be prophets. They will do signs and amazing things to fool God's chosen people, if they can.

vi.L: Vì sẽ nổi lên những {{christos:Christ giả|Mê-si-a giả}} và những tiên tri giả, và chúng sẽ làm những dấu lạ và điềm lạ để lừa gạt, nếu có thể được, cả những người được chọn.
vi.B: Vì những {{christos:Christ giả|Mê-si-a giả}} và những tiên tri giả sẽ nổi lên, làm những dấu lạ và điềm lạ để lừa gạt những người được chọn, nếu điều đó có thể được.
vi.R: Sẽ có những kẻ nói dối rằng mình là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Cũng có những kẻ nói dối rằng mình là nhà tiên tri. Họ sẽ làm những dấu lạ và những việc lạ lùng để lừa gạt dân được Đức Chúa Trời chọn, nếu họ có thể.

ko.L: 거짓 {{christos:그리스도들|메시아들}}과 거짓 예언자들이 일어나서, 할 수만 있다면 택함 받은 사람들을 미혹하려고 표적들과 기이한 일들을 보일 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 거짓 {{christos:그리스도들|메시아들}}과 거짓 예언자들이 나타나서 표적과 기이한 일들을 보이며, 할 수만 있으면 택함 받은 사람들까지도 속이려 할 것이다.
ko.R: 자기가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}라고 거짓으로 주장하는 사람들이 나타날 것이다. 자기가 예언자라고 거짓으로 주장하는 사람들도 나타날 것이다. 그들은 표적과 놀라운 일들을 보여서, 할 수만 있으면 하나님께서 택하신 사람들까지 속이려고 할 것이다.

es.L: Porque se levantarán falsos {{christos:cristos|mesías}} y falsos profetas, y harán señales y prodigios para engañar, si [fuera] posible, a los elegidos.
es.B: Porque surgirán falsos {{christos:cristos|mesías}} y falsos profetas, y harán señales y prodigios para engañar a los elegidos, si eso fuera posible.
es.R: Vendrán personas que dirán falsamente que son el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}. Otras dirán falsamente que son profetas. Harán señales y cosas asombrosas para engañar al pueblo que Dios ha elegido, si pueden.

fr.L: Car il se lèvera de faux {{christos:christs|messies}} et de faux prophètes, et ils donneront des signes et des prodiges pour égarer, si possible, les élus.
fr.B: Car de faux {{christos:christs|messies}} et de faux prophètes se lèveront et feront des signes et des prodiges, pour égarer les élus, si c’était possible.
fr.R: Des gens viendront et prétendront faussement être le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. D’autres prétendront faussement être des prophètes. Ils feront des signes et des choses extraordinaires pour tromper les gens que Dieu a choisis, s’ils le peuvent.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{christos:makristo|masihi}} wa uongo na manabii wa uongo watainuka, nao watatoa ishara na maajabu ili kuwapotosha, ikiwezekana, wateule.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{christos:makristo|masihi}} wa uongo na manabii wa uongo watatokea, nao watafanya ishara na maajabu ili kuwapotosha wateule, kama ingewezekana.
sw.R: Watatokea watu watakaojidai kwa uongo kwamba wao ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Wengine watajidai kwa uongo kwamba ni manabii. Watafanya ishara na mambo ya ajabu ili kuwadanganya watu wateule wa Mungu, kama wakiweza.

pt.L: Pois surgirão falsos {{christos:cristos|messias}} e falsos profetas, e farão sinais e prodígios para enganar, se possível, os eleitos.
pt.B: Pois surgirão falsos {{christos:cristos|messias}} e falsos profetas, que farão sinais e prodígios para desencaminhar os escolhidos, se isso fosse possível.
pt.R: Vão aparecer pessoas dizendo falsamente que são o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}. Outras vão dizer falsamente que são profetas. Elas vão fazer sinais e coisas espantosas para enganar o povo escolhido de Deus, se puderem.

decisions.choice: false christs: people who falsely claim to be the Messiah
decisions.reason: The word joins "false" and "Christ". It means pretenders to the title of Messiah.

decisions.choice: false prophets with signs and wonders: as in Deuteronomy 13:1-3
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 13:1-3 warns that a prophet may give a sign or wonder that comes true and still lead people after other gods. Signs alone do not prove a messenger is from God.

decisions.choice: if possible: they will try, though it may not be possible
decisions.reason: The phrase shows how strong the deception will be. It also hints that God will keep his chosen ones from being led away.

decisions.choice: signs and wonders: works that seem to show power from God
decisions.reason: The pair is the Old Testament phrase for God's mighty acts, as in Egypt (Deuteronomy 6:22).

decisions.choice: who falsely claim to be the Messiah; God's chosen people
alternatives: false Christs, false prophets; the elect
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two compound words mean and whose chosen people they are.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ giả|Mê-si-a giả}} (L, B), without "Đấng"
decisions.reason: The honorific "Đấng" is not given to impostors, so the span holds the bare title with "giả" (false); Readable says what they do and uses the full span for the one they claim to be.

decisions.choice: "dấu lạ và điềm lạ" (L, B); "dấu lạ và những việc lạ lùng" (R)
decisions.reason: "Dấu lạ" is the style guide's word for "sign"; "điềm lạ" is a portent, the sense of "wonders". Neither is "phép lạ" (miracle), which would grant that the deeds come from God.

decisions.choice: 거짓 {{christos:그리스도들|메시아들}}; "거짓 예언자들"
decisions.reason: The span covers the noun, as the English one does. "예언자" is preferred to the older "선지자" (style guide, Settled; Korean John).

decisions.choice: {{christos:makristo|masihi}} wa uongo
alternatives: watu wanaojiita Kristo kwa uongo (L, B)
decisions.reason: The plural takes the ma- prefix that Swahili uses for titles of persons. 'Wakristo' would mean Christians, which is not what is said; 'masihi' is the same in the plural. Readable says it with a clause, as the English Readable does. A native reviewer should confirm that 'makristo' reads naturally.

source.text: ὑμεῖς δὲ βλέπετε· προείρηκα ὑμῖν πάντα.

records.literal_gloss: You however take heed; I have foretold to you all things.

en.L: But you, take care; I have told you all things beforehand.
en.B: So you must be on your guard. I have told you all of it in advance.
en.R: So be careful! I have warned you about all this before it happens.

vi.L: Còn các con, hãy coi chừng; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói trước với các con mọi điều.
vi.B: Vậy các con phải đề phòng. Ta đã báo trước cho các con mọi điều.
vi.R: Vậy hãy cẩn thận! Ta đã cảnh báo các con về mọi điều này trước khi chúng xảy ra.

ko.L: 그러나 너희는 주의하여라. 내가 너희에게 모든 것을 미리 말하였다.
ko.B: 그러니 너희는 조심하여라. 내가 이 모든 것을 너희에게 미리 말해 두었다.
ko.R: 그러니 조심하여라! 이 모든 일이 일어나기 전에 내가 너희에게 미리 경고해 두었다.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes, miren|vosotros, mirad}}; {{plural_you:les|os}} he dicho todo de antemano.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:ustedes estén|vosotros estad}} alerta. {{plural_you:Se lo|Os lo}} he dicho todo por adelantado.
es.R: ¡Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado! {{plural_you:Les|Os}} he advertido de todo esto antes de que pase.

fr.L: Mais vous, prenez garde ; je vous ai tout dit d’avance.
fr.B: Vous donc, soyez sur vos gardes. Je vous ai tout annoncé à l’avance.
fr.R: Alors faites attention ! Je vous ai avertis de tout cela avant que ça arrive.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi angalieni; nimewaambia mambo yote mapema.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ninyi jihadharini. Nimewaambia yote mapema.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo kuweni waangalifu! Nimewaonya kuhusu mambo haya yote kabla hayajatokea.

pt.L: Mas vocês, cuidem; eu lhes disse tudo de antemão.
pt.B: Por isso, fiquem atentos. Eu lhes disse tudo com antecedência.
pt.R: Então, cuidado! Eu já avisei vocês sobre tudo isso antes que aconteça.

decisions.choice: you: stressed, you as opposed to those who are misled
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out for emphasis: whatever others do, you be on guard.

decisions.choice: all things: everything they need to know about these events
decisions.reason: Jesus has told them all they need to keep from being deceived, not every detail of what will happen.

decisions.choice: warned you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the telling is for.

source.text: Ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν ἐκείνην ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται, καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες ἔσονται ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πίπτοντες, καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς σαλευθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: But in those days after the tribulation that the sun will be darkened, and the moon not will give the light of it, \v 25 and the stars will be out of the heaven falling, and the powers that in the heavens will be shaken.

en.L: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, \v 25 and the stars will be falling out of heaven, and the powers that [are] in the heavens will be shaken.
en.B: But in those days, after that time of distress, the sun will grow dark and the moon will give no light. \v 25 Stars will come falling from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
en.R: In those days, after that time of terrible trouble, the sun will become dark. The moon will not shine. \v 25 Stars will fall from the sky. The powers in the heavens will be shaken.

vi.L: Nhưng trong những ngày ấy, sau hoạn nạn đó, mặt trời sẽ tối tăm, và mặt trăng sẽ không tỏa ánh sáng của nó, \v 25 và các ngôi sao sẽ từ trời rơi xuống, và các quyền lực ở trên các tầng trời sẽ bị rúng động.
vi.B: Nhưng trong những ngày ấy, sau cơn hoạn nạn đó, mặt trời sẽ tối sầm và mặt trăng không còn chiếu sáng. \v 25 Các ngôi sao sẽ từ trời sa xuống, và các quyền lực trên các tầng trời sẽ bị rúng động.
vi.R: Trong những ngày ấy, sau thời kỳ vô cùng khốn khổ đó, mặt trời sẽ tối đi. Mặt trăng sẽ không chiếu sáng nữa. \v 25 Các ngôi sao sẽ từ trời rơi xuống. Các quyền lực trên các tầng trời sẽ bị rúng động.

ko.L: 그러나 그 날들에, 그 환난 뒤에, 해가 어둡게 될 것이고, 달은 자기 빛을 주지 않을 것이며, \v 25 별들이 하늘에서 떨어지고 있을 것이고, 하늘들 안에 있는 능력들이 흔들릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그 날에, 그 고난이 지나간 뒤에, 해는 빛을 잃고 달은 빛을 비추지 않을 것이다. \v 25 별들이 하늘에서 떨어지고, 하늘의 권세들이 흔들릴 것이다.
ko.R: 그 끔찍한 고통의 때가 지나고 나면, 그 날에 해가 어두워질 것이다. 달도 빛을 내지 않을 것이다. \v 25 별들이 하늘에서 떨어질 것이다. 하늘에 있는 세력들이 흔들릴 것이다.

es.L: Pero en aquellos días, después de aquella tribulación, el sol se oscurecerá, y la luna no dará su resplandor, \v 25 y las estrellas estarán cayendo del cielo, y los poderes que [están] en los cielos serán sacudidos.
es.B: Pero en aquellos días, después de esa angustia, el sol se oscurecerá y la luna no dará su luz. \v 25 Las estrellas caerán del cielo, y los poderes de los cielos serán sacudidos.
es.R: En aquellos días, después de ese tiempo de sufrimiento terrible, el sol se pondrá oscuro. La luna no brillará. \v 25 Las estrellas caerán del cielo. Los poderes que hay en los cielos serán sacudidos.

fr.L: Mais en ces jours-là, après cette tribulation-là, le soleil sera obscurci, et la lune ne donnera pas son éclat, \v 25 et les étoiles seront en train de tomber du ciel, et les puissances qui [sont] dans les cieux seront ébranlées.
fr.B: Mais en ces jours-là, après ce temps de détresse, le soleil deviendra sombre et la lune ne donnera plus de lumière. \v 25 Des étoiles viendront tomber du ciel, et les puissances des cieux seront secouées.
fr.R: En ces jours-là, après ce temps de terribles malheurs, le soleil deviendra noir. La lune ne brillera plus. \v 25 Des étoiles tomberont du ciel. Les puissances qui sont dans le ciel seront secouées.

sw.L: Lakini katika siku hizo, baada ya dhiki ile, jua litatiwa giza, na mwezi hautatoa mwanga wake, \v 25 na nyota zitakuwa zikianguka kutoka mbinguni, na nguvu zilizo katika mbingu zitatikiswa.
sw.B: Lakini katika siku hizo, baada ya wakati ule wa dhiki, jua litatiwa giza na mwezi hautatoa mwanga. \v 25 Nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu zilizo mbinguni zitatikiswa.
sw.R: Katika siku hizo, baada ya wakati ule wa taabu kubwa, jua litakuwa giza. Mwezi hautaangaza. \v 25 Nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani. Nguvu zilizo mbinguni zitatikiswa.

pt.L: Mas, naqueles dias, depois daquela tribulação, o sol escurecerá, e a lua não dará a sua claridade, \v 25 e as estrelas estarão caindo do céu, e os poderes que [estão] nos céus serão abalados.
pt.B: Mas, naqueles dias, depois daquele tempo de aflição, o sol vai escurecer e a lua não dará a sua luz. \v 25 As estrelas cairão do céu, e os poderes que estão nos céus serão abalados.
pt.R: Naqueles dias, depois daquele tempo de sofrimento terrível, o sol vai ficar escuro. A lua não vai brilhar. \v 25 As estrelas vão cair do céu. Os poderes que estão nos céus vão ser abalados.

decisions.choice: sun, moon and stars: in the words of Isaiah 13:10 and 34:4
alternatives: a new prophecy with no source
decisions.reason: Isaiah 13:10 says the sun will be dark and the moon will not give its light; Isaiah 34:4 says the host of heaven will fall. Joel 2:10 and 3:15 speak the same way.

decisions.choice: darkened sun and falling stars: the prophets' language for God acting in judgment
alternatives: only a description of the physical sky
decisions.reason: Isaiah used these words about the fall of Babylon (Isaiah 13). Such language marks a great act of God that shakes the world. How literally it is meant here is not certain.

decisions.choice: the powers in the heavens: the heavenly bodies, or spiritual powers ruling there
decisions.reason: "Powers" can mean the sun, moon and stars as the host of heaven, or spiritual beings. Both were thought of together.

decisions.choice: in those days, after that tribulation: a new stage after the distress of 13:14-23
alternatives: the same moment as the distress
decisions.reason: "But" and "after" mark a turn from the troubles to what follows them.

decisions.choice: sky
decisions.reason: The same Greek word means both sky and heaven. Where stars fall, Balanced and Readable say sky.

decisions.choice: "능력들" (L); "권세들" (B); "세력들" (R) for the powers in the heavens
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether the heavenly bodies or spiritual powers are meant; each level uses a word that can carry both, rather than "천체" (heavenly bodies), which would decide it.

decisions.choice: cielo
decisions.reason: Spanish "cielo" means both sky and heaven, so every level keeps the one word of the Greek.

decisions.choice: mwanga
decisions.reason: The moon's light is physical light, so Swahili uses the everyday 'mwanga'; 'nuru' is kept for light as a figure, as in John.

decisions.choice: do céu
decisions.reason: Portuguese "céu" means both sky and heaven, as the Greek word does, so the choice the English makes between "sky" and "heaven" does not arise (also 13:27, 31).

source.text: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλαις μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ δόξης·

records.literal_gloss: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with power great and glory.

en.L: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
en.B: Then people will see the Son of Man come in clouds, with great power and glory.
en.R: Then everyone will see the Son of Man come in the clouds. He will come with great power and glory.

vi.L: Và bấy giờ người ta sẽ thấy Con Người đến trong những đám mây với quyền năng lớn và vinh quang.
vi.B: Bấy giờ người ta sẽ thấy Con Người đến trong mây, với quyền năng lớn và vinh quang.
vi.R: Bấy giờ mọi người sẽ thấy Con Người đến trong mây. Con Người sẽ đến với quyền năng lớn và vinh quang.

ko.L: 그리고 그때에 그들은 인자가 구름들 가운데 큰 능력과 영광과 함께 오는 것을 볼 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 사람들은 인자가 큰 권능과 영광을 지니고 구름 가운데 오는 것을 볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그때 모든 사람이 인자가 구름 가운데 오는 것을 볼 것이다. 인자는 큰 권능과 영광을 지니고 올 것이다.

es.L: Y entonces verán al Hijo del Hombre viniendo en nubes con gran poder y gloria.
es.B: Entonces la gente verá al Hijo del Hombre venir en las nubes, con gran poder y gloria.
es.R: Entonces todos verán al Hijo del Hombre venir en las nubes. Vendrá con gran poder y gloria.

fr.L: Et alors ils verront le Fils de l’homme venant dans des nuées avec une grande puissance et [une grande] gloire.
fr.B: Alors on verra le Fils de l’homme venir dans des nuées, avec beaucoup de puissance et de gloire.
fr.R: Alors tout le monde verra le Fils de l’homme venir dans les nuages. Il viendra avec une grande puissance et une grande gloire.

sw.L: Na ndipo watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika mawingu pamoja na nguvu nyingi na utukufu.
sw.B: Ndipo watu watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika mawingu, kwa nguvu kuu na utukufu.
sw.R: Ndipo kila mtu atamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika mawingu. Atakuja kwa nguvu kuu na utukufu.

pt.L: E então verão o Filho do Homem vindo em nuvens com grande poder e glória.
pt.B: Então as pessoas verão o Filho do Homem vir nas nuvens, com grande poder e glória.
pt.R: Então todos vão ver o Filho do Homem vir nas nuvens. Ele vai chegar com grande poder e glória.

decisions.choice: the Son of Man coming in clouds: Daniel 7:13
decisions.reason: In Daniel 7:13-14 one like a son of man comes with the clouds of heaven and is given authority and a kingdom that will never end. Jesus uses the title of himself throughout Mark.

decisions.choice: coming: the Son of Man coming in glory at the end
alternatives: only his going up to God to be crowned
decisions.reason: In Daniel the son of man comes to the Ancient of Days. Some read Jesus' words as his going to God in triumph. The angels gathering the elect in 13:27 point to his coming to earth.

decisions.choice: they will see: people in general
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. It means people will see.

decisions.choice: people (B); everyone (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "they" are.

decisions.choice: "인자" for the Son of Man, every level, through Mark
decisions.reason: A title, as in the Korean John; Jesus speaks of himself, so it takes no honorific in his mouth. Never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: el Hijo del Hombre
decisions.reason: A title, with capitals and no gender setting, as in the Spanish of John.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu
decisions.reason: The title as settled for John (1:51): 'Adamu' is also a word for humankind, so it keeps the sense of 'son of man' in Daniel 7:13, which this verse echoes. Never under the gender setting.

source.text: καὶ τότε ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐπισυνάξει τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ’ ἄκρου γῆς ἕως ἄκρου οὐρανοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And then he will send the angels and will gather together the elect from the four winds from end of earth to end of heaven.

en.L: And then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will send out the angels and will gather together the elect from the four winds, from [the] end of earth to [the] end of heaven.
en.B: And then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will send out the angels and gather the chosen ones from all four winds, from the farthest edge of the earth to the farthest edge of the sky.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will send out the angels. They will gather God's chosen people from every direction, from one end of the earth and sky to the other.

vi.L: Và bấy giờ [Con Người] sẽ sai các thiên sứ đi và sẽ nhóm họp những người được chọn từ bốn phương gió, từ đầu cùng đất đến đầu cùng trời.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Con Người sẽ sai các thiên sứ đi và nhóm họp những người được chọn từ bốn phương trời, từ tận cùng mặt đất đến tận cùng bầu trời.
vi.R: Rồi Con Người sẽ sai các thiên sứ đi. Họ sẽ tập hợp dân được Đức Chúa Trời chọn từ khắp mọi nơi, từ đầu này đến đầu kia của đất và trời.

ko.L: 그리고 그때에 그가 천사들을 보낼 것이고, 택함 받은 사람들을 네 바람으로부터, 땅 끝에서 하늘 끝까지 모을 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 인자는 천사들을 보내어, 땅 끝에서 하늘 끝까지 사방에서 택함 받은 사람들을 모을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때 인자는 천사들을 보낼 것이다. 천사들은 하나님께서 택하신 사람들을 온 세상 모든 곳에서 모을 것이다. 땅 이 끝에서 하늘 저 끝까지 모을 것이다.

es.L: Y entonces enviará a los ángeles y reunirá a los elegidos de los cuatro vientos, desde [el] extremo de [la] tierra hasta [el] extremo del cielo.
es.B: Entonces enviará a los ángeles y reunirá a los elegidos de los cuatro vientos, desde el último rincón de la tierra hasta el último rincón del cielo.
es.R: Entonces enviará a los ángeles. Ellos reunirán al pueblo que Dios ha elegido desde todas las direcciones, de un extremo al otro de la tierra y del cielo.

fr.L: Et alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enverra les anges et rassemblera les élus des quatre vents, depuis le bout de [la] terre jusqu’au bout du ciel.
fr.B: Il enverra alors les anges, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rassemblera les élus des quatre vents, depuis l’extrémité de la terre jusqu’à l’extrémité du ciel.
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enverra les anges. Ils rassembleront les gens que Dieu a choisis, de tous les côtés, d’un bout à l’autre de la terre et du ciel.

sw.L: Na ndipo atawatuma malaika na kuwakusanya wateule kutoka pande nne za upepo, kutoka mwisho wa dunia hadi mwisho wa mbingu.
sw.B: Kisha atawatuma malaika na kuwakusanya wateule kutoka pande zote nne za upepo, kutoka mwisho kabisa wa dunia hadi mwisho kabisa wa anga.
sw.R: Kisha atawatuma malaika. Nao watawakusanya watu wateule wa Mungu kutoka kila upande, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa dunia na anga hadi mwisho mwingine.

pt.L: E então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviará os anjos e reunirá os eleitos dos quatro ventos, desde [a] extremidade da terra até [a] extremidade do céu.
pt.B: E então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviará os anjos e reunirá os escolhidos dos quatro ventos, desde o ponto mais distante da terra até o ponto mais distante do céu.
pt.R: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai enviar os anjos. Eles vão reunir o povo escolhido de Deus de todas as direções, de uma ponta à outra da terra e do céu.

decisions.choice: gathering the elect from the four winds: as God promised to gather his scattered people
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 30:4 promises to gather Israel even from the end of heaven, and Zechariah 2:6 speaks of the four winds. Now the Son of Man gathers the chosen.

decisions.choice: the four winds: the four directions, everywhere
decisions.reason: The four winds are north, south, east and west.

decisions.choice: from the end of earth to the end of heaven: from every corner of the world
decisions.reason: The phrase joins two Old Testament ways of saying "everywhere": the ends of the earth and the ends of the sky, where they seem to meet.

decisions.choice: the angels, the elect: the SBLGNT reading
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "his angels" and "his elect", as in Matthew 24:31. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: God's chosen people
decisions.reason: Readable says whose chosen people they are, as in 13:20.

decisions.choice: "Con Người" as the subject, where the English has "he" with the deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a subject. Jesus is speaking of himself as the Son of Man, and he would not call himself "Ngài", the narrator's word for him; repeating the title is how Vietnamese avoids it. Literal brackets it because the Greek has only the verb.

decisions.choice: "인자는" (B, R) as the subject
decisions.reason: Korean avoids "he" for a person it has just named; Balanced and Readable repeat the title from 13:26 so it is clear who sends the angels. Literal keeps "그가".

decisions.choice: "네 바람으로부터" (L); "사방에서" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture; Balanced uses the Korean word for the four directions, which says what the idiom means (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: enviará, with no pronoun
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the Son of Man in the verb, so the English span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: pande nne za upepo
decisions.reason: 'Pepo' is the plural of 'upepo' (wind), but it is also the word for evil spirits, so 'pepo nne' could be misheard. 'Pande nne za upepo' (the four quarters of the wind) keeps the picture and the meaning, the four directions.

source.text: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν· ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς ἁπαλὸς γένηται καὶ ἐκφύῃ τὰ φύλλα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν·

records.literal_gloss: From now the fig tree learn the parable: when already the branch of it tender becomes and puts out the leaves, you know that near the summer is.

en.L: Now from the fig tree learn the parable: when its branch has already become tender and puts out the leaves, you know that the summer is near.
en.B: Learn this parable from the fig tree. Once its branch turns soft and its leaves sprout, you know summer is close.
en.R: Learn a lesson from the fig tree. When its branches get soft and green and new leaves begin to grow, you know that summer will soon be here.

vi.L: Vậy hãy học ngụ ngôn từ cây vả: khi cành nó đã non mềm và nảy lá, các con biết rằng mùa hè đã gần.
vi.B: Hãy học lấy ngụ ngôn từ cây vả. Khi cành vả trở nên mềm mại và nảy lộc, các con biết mùa hè đã gần.
vi.R: Hãy học một bài học từ cây vả. Khi cành của nó trở nên mềm và xanh, lá non bắt đầu mọc ra, các con biết mùa hè sắp đến.

ko.L: 이제 무화과나무에서 비유를 배워라. 그 가지가 이미 연해지고 잎들을 내면, 너희는 여름이 가까운 줄 안다.
ko.B: 무화과나무에서 이 비유를 배워라. 가지가 부드러워지고 잎이 돋으면, 너희는 여름이 가까이 온 줄 안다.
ko.R: 무화과나무에서 한 가지 교훈을 배워라. 가지가 부드럽고 푸르게 되고 새 잎이 돋기 시작하면, 너희는 곧 여름이 온다는 것을 안다.

es.L: Y de la higuera {{plural_you:aprendan|aprended}} la parábola: cuando ya su rama se pone tierna y echa las hojas, {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que el verano está cerca.
es.B: {{plural_you:Aprendan|Aprended}} esta parábola de la higuera. En cuanto sus ramas se ponen tiernas y le brotan las hojas, {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que el verano está cerca.
es.R: {{plural_you:Aprendan|Aprended}} una lección de la higuera. Cuando sus ramas se ponen blandas y verdes y empiezan a salirle hojas nuevas, {{plural_you:ustedes saben|vosotros sabéis}} que pronto llegará el verano.

fr.L: Or, apprenez du figuier la parabole : quand sa branche est déjà devenue tendre et qu’elle pousse ses feuilles, vous savez que l’été est proche.
fr.B: Que le figuier vous serve de parabole. Dès que sa branche s’attendrit et que ses feuilles sortent, vous savez que l’été approche.
fr.R: Apprenez une leçon du figuier. Quand ses branches deviennent souples et vertes et que de nouvelles feuilles commencent à pousser, vous savez que l’été arrive bientôt.

sw.L: Basi kutoka kwa mtini jifunzeni mfano: tawi lake linapokwisha kuwa laini na kuchipua majani, mnajua kwamba kiangazi kiko karibu.
sw.B: Jifunzeni mfano huu kutoka kwa mtini. Tawi lake linapoanza kuwa laini na majani yake kuchipua, mnajua kwamba kiangazi kimekaribia.
sw.R: Jifunzeni somo kutokana na mtini. Matawi yake yanapokuwa laini na ya kijani, na majani mapya kuanza kuchipua, mnajua kwamba kiangazi kinakaribia.

pt.L: E da figueira aprendam a parábola: quando o seu ramo já fica tenro e lança as folhas, vocês sabem que o verão está próximo.
pt.B: Aprendam esta parábola da figueira. Quando os seus ramos ficam macios e as folhas brotam, vocês sabem que o verão está perto.
pt.R: Aprendam uma lição com a figueira. Quando os galhos dela ficam verdes e macios e as folhas novas começam a nascer, vocês sabem que o verão está chegando.

decisions.choice: the fig tree's leaves: a sign of summer
decisions.reason: Most trees in the land of Israel keep their leaves all year. The fig loses its leaves in winter, and new ones come late in spring, so its leaves are a sure sign that summer is near.

decisions.choice: parable: a comparison that teaches a lesson
decisions.reason: Here the parable is a short comparison from nature.

decisions.choice: the fig tree: perhaps recalling the fig tree of 11:12-14 and 11:20-21
decisions.reason: Earlier a fig tree without fruit stood for judgment. Here the fig tree's new leaves show that something is near.

decisions.choice: lesson
decisions.reason: As elsewhere, Readable avoids "parable". Here the word means the lesson the fig tree teaches.

decisions.choice: "bài học" (R); "ngụ ngôn" (L, B), as in 4:2
decisions.reason: Here the parable is a lesson drawn from the fig tree, not a story; Readable says "bài học", as the English Readable says "lesson". Literal and Balanced keep the book's word for a parable.

decisions.choice: "교훈" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the parable is a short comparison that teaches a lesson (meaning decision), not a story; Readable says "교훈" (lesson), as the English Readable does. Literal and Balanced keep "비유".

decisions.choice: kiangazi
decisions.reason: In Judea summer is the hot dry season of ripening fruit, which Swahili calls 'kiangazi'. 'Majira ya joto' is a translation of the European season.

source.text: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις.

records.literal_gloss: So also you, when you see these things happening, know that near it is at doors.

en.L: So also you, when you see these things happening, know that [it] is near, at [the] doors.
en.B: So too with you: when you see these things happening, be sure that it is near, right at the door.
en.R: In the same way, when you see these things happening, you can be sure that the time is near. It is right at the door.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, các con, khi thấy những điều này xảy ra, hãy biết rằng [điều ấy] đã gần, ở ngay trước cửa.
vi.B: Các con cũng vậy: khi thấy những điều này xảy ra, hãy biết chắc rằng điều ấy đã gần, ngay trước cửa rồi.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, khi các con thấy những điều này xảy ra, các con có thể biết chắc rằng thời điểm ấy đã gần. Nó đã ở ngay trước cửa rồi.

ko.L: 이와 같이 너희도 이런 일들이 일어나는 것을 보거든, [그것이] 가까이, 문들 앞에 와 있는 줄 알아라.
ko.B: 마찬가지로 너희도 이런 일들이 일어나는 것을 보면, 그것이 가까이 왔다는 것을, 바로 문 앞에 와 있다는 것을 알아라.
ko.R: 이와 같이 이런 일들이 일어나는 것을 보면, 그때가 가까이 왔다는 것을 알아라. 그때가 바로 문 앞에 와 있다.

es.L: Así también {{plural_you:ustedes, cuando vean|vosotros, cuando veáis}} que suceden estas cosas, {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que está cerca, a [las] puertas.
es.B: Lo mismo {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que suceden estas cosas, {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que está cerca, a la puerta misma.
es.R: Del mismo modo, cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que pasan estas cosas, {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} estar seguros de que el momento está cerca. Está ya a la puerta.

fr.L: Ainsi vous aussi, quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, sachez que [c’]est proche, aux portes.
fr.B: De même, vous aussi, quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, sachez que c’est proche, tout près de la porte.
fr.R: De la même façon, quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, vous pourrez être sûrs que le moment est proche. Il est juste à la porte.

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo ninyi pia, mtakapoyaona mambo haya yakitokea, jueni kwamba ni karibu, milangoni.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo nanyi, mtakapoyaona mambo haya yakitokea, jueni kwa hakika kwamba ni karibu, mlangoni kabisa.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, mtakapoyaona mambo haya yakitokea, mnaweza kujua kwa hakika kwamba wakati umekaribia. Uko mlangoni kabisa.

pt.L: Assim também vocês, quando virem estas coisas acontecendo, saibam que [isso] está próximo, às portas.
pt.B: O mesmo vale para vocês: quando virem essas coisas acontecendo, tenham certeza de que está perto, já à porta.
pt.R: Do mesmo modo, quando vocês virem essas coisas acontecendo, podem ter certeza de que o tempo está perto. Já está à porta.

decisions.choice: is near: the subject is not stated; the end, or the coming of the Son of Man
alternatives: he is near: the Son of Man himself
decisions.reason: The verb has no subject, so it can mean "it is near" or "he is near". Luke 21:31 says "the kingdom of God is near". The coming of the Son of Man in 13:26 is what is near in either reading.

decisions.choice: these things: the troubles and signs of 13:5-23
alternatives: the darkening of the sun and the coming itself
decisions.reason: "These things" are what come before the end, as in the disciples' question (13:4).

decisions.choice: know: a command
decisions.reason: The same form can be a command or a statement. After "so also you" it is most likely a command.

decisions.choice: at the doors: very close
alternatives: at the doors of the temple
decisions.reason: To be at the door is to be about to come in.

decisions.choice: the time is near
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject as the time of these events, which keeps both readings open as far as English allows.

decisions.choice: [그것이] (L); "그것이" (B)
decisions.reason: The subject is not stated (meaning decision, footnoted): the end or the coming of the Son of Man. "그것" leaves both open, as the English "it" does; Readable says "그때", as the English Readable says "the time".

decisions.choice: está cerca, with no subject
decisions.reason: Spanish can leave the subject in the verb, as the Greek does, so Literal and Balanced need no "it" and leave open whether the end or the Son of Man is near (meaning decision m1). Readable says "el momento", as the English says "the time".

decisions.choice: ni karibu, with no subject
alternatives: uko karibu (it, the time, is near)
decisions.reason: The Greek does not say what is near: the end, or the Son of Man (meaning decision, with footnote). A Swahili verb must carry a subject prefix that would choose between a person and a thing, so Literal and Balanced use the bare copula 'ni karibu' (it is near), which leaves the question open. Readable names 'wakati' (the time), as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη μέχρις οὗ ταῦτα πάντα γένηται.

records.literal_gloss: Truly I say to you that no not will pass away the generation this until these things all have taken place.

en.L: Truly I say to you that this generation will not pass away until all these things have taken place.
en.B: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away before all these things take place.
en.R: I tell you the truth: all these things will happen before the people now living have all died.

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng thế hệ này sẽ không qua đi cho đến khi tất cả những điều này xảy ra.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, thế hệ này chắc chắn sẽ không qua đi trước khi mọi điều này xảy ra.
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con: tất cả những điều này sẽ xảy ra trước khi những người đang sống bây giờ qua đời hết.

ko.L: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 이 모든 일이 일어날 때까지 이 세대는 결코 지나가지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 이 모든 일이 일어나기 전에는 이 세대가 결코 지나가지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 지금 살아 있는 사람들이 다 죽기 전에 이 모든 일이 일어날 것이다.

es.L: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que no pasará esta generación hasta que todas estas cosas sucedan.
es.B: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que esta generación no pasará sin que todas estas cosas sucedan.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: todas estas cosas van a suceder antes de que haya muerto toda la gente que vive ahora.

fr.L: En vérité, je vous le dis : cette génération ne passera absolument pas avant que toutes ces choses soient arrivées.
fr.B: En vérité, je vous le dis : cette génération ne passera certainement pas avant que tout cela soit arrivé.
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : tout cela arrivera avant que les gens qui vivent aujourd’hui soient tous morts.

sw.L: Kweli nawaambia kwamba kizazi hiki hakitapita kamwe mpaka mambo haya yote yatakapokuwa yametokea.
sw.B: Kweli nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita kamwe kabla mambo haya yote hayajatokea.
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli: mambo haya yote yatatokea kabla watu wanaoishi sasa hawajafa wote.

pt.L: Em verdade eu lhes digo que de modo nenhum passará esta geração até que todas estas coisas aconteçam.
pt.B: Em verdade eu lhes digo: esta geração certamente não passará antes que todas estas coisas aconteçam.
pt.R: Eu garanto a vocês: todas estas coisas vão acontecer antes que as pessoas que vivem agora tenham morrido.

decisions.choice: this generation: the people living in Jesus' own time
alternatives: the generation that sees the signs
decisions.reason: Elsewhere in Mark "this generation" means Jesus' contemporaries (8:12, 38; 9:19). Others take it as the people of Israel or the generation alive when the signs begin. The meaning depends on what "all these things" includes.

decisions.choice: all these things: the events of 13:5-23, including the fall of the temple
alternatives: everything in the speech, including the coming of the Son of Man
decisions.reason: "These things" in 13:29 are the signs that come before the end. Read that way, Jesus says his own generation will see them, while the day itself no one knows (13:32).

decisions.choice: will not: a double negative, a firm promise
decisions.reason: The strongest form of denial.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as elsewhere in Mark.

decisions.choice: the people now living
decisions.reason: Readable follows the reading chosen above. If it is wrong, this wording says more than the Greek.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R)
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese John's form for "Truly, truly", with the single word Mark has. Recorded once for the chapter.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R), through Mark 13-14
decisions.reason: As at Mark 3:28, the single form of the Korean John's "진실로 진실로"; modern endings replace the archaic "이르노니".

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R)
alternatives: Je vous le dis en vérité
decisions.reason: The single "Truly" of Mark, in the forms the French of John uses for the double one (French brief, section 5): Literal and Balanced the usual solemn formula, Readable a plain statement. Used the same way through Mark.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The single "Truly" of Mark, in the same words as the Spanish of John uses for its double form ("En verdad, en verdad"). This is the rendering throughout Mark.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's single amen. John's double amen is 'Kweli kweli nawaambia', so the single one is 'Kweli nawaambia', in plain modern Swahili; Readable says 'I tell you the truth', as in John and the English Readable. Used for every 'truly I say to you' in Mark.

decisions.choice: Em verdade eu lhes digo (L, B); Eu garanto a vocês (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Portuguese wording for the formula (style section 6), for this passage.

source.text: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται.

records.literal_gloss: The heaven and the earth will pass away, but the words of me no not will pass away.

en.L: Heaven and earth will pass away, but {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will by no means pass away.
en.B: Heaven and earth will pass away, yet {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will never pass away.
en.R: The sky and the earth will come to an end, but {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will last forever.

vi.L: Trời và đất sẽ qua đi, nhưng các lời của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ không qua đi.
vi.B: Trời đất sẽ qua đi, nhưng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ qua đi.
vi.R: Trời và đất sẽ không còn nữa, nhưng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ còn mãi mãi.

ko.L: 하늘과 땅은 지나갈 것이다. 그러나 내 말들은 결코 지나가지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 하늘과 땅은 사라지겠지만, 내 말은 절대로 사라지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘과 땅은 언젠가 끝날 것이다. 그러나 내 말은 영원히 남을 것이다.

es.L: El cielo y la tierra pasarán, pero {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras de ningún modo pasarán.
es.B: El cielo y la tierra pasarán, pero {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras nunca pasarán.
es.R: El cielo y la tierra llegarán a su fin, pero {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras durarán para siempre.

fr.L: Le ciel et la terre passeront, mais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles ne passeront absolument pas.
fr.B: Le ciel et la terre disparaîtront, mais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles ne disparaîtront jamais.
fr.R: Le ciel et la terre prendront fin, mais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dureront toujours.

sw.L: Mbingu na dunia zitapita, lakini maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hakika hayatapita.
sw.B: Mbingu na dunia zitatoweka, lakini maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hayatatoweka kamwe.
sw.R: Anga na dunia vitafikia mwisho, lakini maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yatadumu milele.

pt.L: O céu e a terra passarão, mas as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras de modo nenhum passarão.
pt.B: O céu e a terra passarão, mas as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras jamais passarão.
pt.R: O céu e a terra vão acabar, mas as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras vão durar para sempre.

decisions.choice: heaven and earth pass, my words remain: as God's word stands forever
decisions.reason: Isaiah 40:8 says the word of our God stands forever, and Isaiah 51:6 says the heavens will vanish like smoke. Jesus says of his own words what the prophets said of God's word.

decisions.choice: will by no means pass away: a double negative
decisions.reason: The strongest denial: his words will never fail.

decisions.choice: come to an end; last forever
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for passing away and never passing away.

decisions.choice: "지나가다" (L), as in 13:30
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same verb for the generation in 13:30 and for heaven and earth here; Literal keeps one Korean verb for both.

source.text: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἢ τῆς ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι ἐν οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ὁ υἱός, εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ.

records.literal_gloss: Concerning now the day that or the hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven nor the Son, except the Father.

en.L: But concerning that day or the hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, except the Father.
en.B: As for that day or hour, nobody knows it, neither the angels in heaven nor the Son. Only the Father knows.
en.R: But no one knows the day or the hour when this will happen. The angels in heaven do not know. Even the Son does not know. Only the Father knows.

vi.L: Nhưng về ngày đó hoặc giờ đó thì không ai biết, ngay cả các thiên sứ trên trời, ngay cả Con cũng không, chỉ có Cha [biết] mà thôi.
vi.B: Còn về ngày ấy hay giờ ấy thì không ai biết, kể cả các thiên sứ trên trời hay Con cũng không biết. Chỉ một mình Cha biết mà thôi.
vi.R: Nhưng không ai biết ngày nào hay giờ nào việc này sẽ xảy ra. Các thiên sứ trên trời không biết. Ngay cả Con cũng không biết. Chỉ có Cha biết mà thôi.

ko.L: 그러나 그 날이나 그 때에 대해서는 아무도 모른다. 하늘에 있는 천사들도 모르고, 아들도 모르고, 오직 아버지만 아신다.
ko.B: 그 날이나 그 때는 아무도 모른다. 하늘의 천사들도 모르고 아들도 모른다. 오직 아버지께서만 아신다.
ko.R: 그러나 이 일이 일어날 날과 때는 아무도 모른다. 하늘에 있는 천사들도 모른다. 아들조차도 모른다. 오직 아버지께서만 아신다.

es.L: Pero acerca de aquel día o de la hora nadie sabe, ni siquiera los ángeles en [el] cielo, ni el Hijo, sino el Padre.
es.B: En cuanto a ese día o esa hora, nadie lo sabe, ni los ángeles en el cielo ni el Hijo. Solo el Padre lo sabe.
es.R: Pero nadie sabe el día ni la hora en que esto sucederá. Los ángeles del cielo no lo saben. Ni siquiera el Hijo lo sabe. Solo el Padre lo sabe.

fr.L: Mais quant à ce jour-là ou à l’heure, personne ne [les] connaît, pas même les anges dans le ciel, ni le Fils, sinon le Père.
fr.B: Quant à ce jour-là ou à cette heure-là, personne ne les connaît : ni les anges dans le ciel, ni le Fils. Le Père seul les connaît.
fr.R: Mais personne ne sait quel jour ni à quelle heure cela arrivera. Les anges dans le ciel ne le savent pas. Même le Fils ne le sait pas. Seul le Père le sait.

sw.L: Lakini kuhusu siku ile au saa, hakuna anayejua, hata malaika walio mbinguni, wala Mwana, isipokuwa Baba.
sw.B: Kuhusu siku ile au saa ile, hakuna anayeijua, wala malaika walio mbinguni, wala Mwana. Ni Baba peke yake anayejua.
sw.R: Lakini hakuna mtu anayejua siku wala saa jambo hili litakapotokea. Malaika walio mbinguni hawajui. Hata Mwana hajui. Baba peke yake ndiye anayejua.

pt.L: Mas, a respeito daquele dia ou da hora, ninguém sabe, nem os anjos no céu, nem o Filho, senão o Pai.
pt.B: Quanto àquele dia ou hora, ninguém sabe, nem os anjos no céu, nem o Filho. Só o Pai sabe.
pt.R: Mas ninguém sabe o dia ou a hora em que isso vai acontecer. Os anjos no céu não sabem. Nem o Filho sabe. Só o Pai sabe.

decisions.choice: that day: the day of the Son of Man's coming (13:26)
alternatives: the day of the temple's fall
decisions.reason: "That day" is the prophets' phrase for the day of the Lord. Here it is the day of the coming just described.

decisions.choice: nor the Son: Jesus says that he, the Son, does not know the day
alternatives: the Son knows but will not tell
decisions.reason: Mark records this plainly. The Son shares the life of the Father, yet as he lives among people he does not know the day; the Father alone has set it. The text does not explain this further.

decisions.choice: the Son, the Father: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son of God the Father
decisions.reason: Only here in Mark does Jesus call himself simply "the Son" beside "the Father".

decisions.choice: when this will happen; Even the Son does not know
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the list into short sentences and says what the day is.

decisions.choice: "Con" and "Cha", capitalised, with no setting
decisions.reason: As in John, "Con" and "Cha" are nouns for the Son and the Father, always capitalised; the style guide gives them no setting span.

decisions.choice: "아들도 모른다" with no honorific; "아버지께서만 아신다" with it
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son, so he does not honour himself, as with "인자"; he honours the Father.

source.text: βλέπετε ἀγρυπνεῖτε, οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ καιρός ἐστιν·

records.literal_gloss: Take heed, keep awake; not you know for when the time is.

en.L: Take care, stay awake; for you do not know when the time is.
en.B: Be on your guard and stay alert, because you do not know when the time will come.
en.R: So be careful! Stay awake! You do not know when that time will come.

vi.L: Hãy coi chừng, hãy tỉnh táo; vì các con không biết khi nào là thời điểm ấy.
vi.B: Hãy đề phòng và tỉnh táo, vì các con không biết khi nào thời điểm ấy sẽ đến.
vi.R: Vậy hãy cẩn thận! Hãy tỉnh táo! Các con không biết khi nào thời điểm ấy sẽ đến.

ko.L: 주의하여라, 깨어 있어라. 그 시기가 언제인지 너희가 알지 못하기 때문이다.
ko.B: 조심하고 깨어 있어라. 그 때가 언제 올지 너희는 모른다.
ko.R: 그러니 조심하여라! 잠들지 말고 깨어 있어라! 그 때가 언제 올지 너희는 모른다.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:velen|velad}}; porque no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} cuándo es el tiempo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} alerta y {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} despiertos, porque no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} cuándo llegará el momento.
es.R: ¡Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado! ¡{{plural_you:Manténganse|Manteneos}} despiertos! {{plural_you:Ustedes no saben|Vosotros no sabéis}} cuándo llegará ese momento.

fr.L: Prenez garde, veillez ; car vous ne savez pas quand c’est le moment.
fr.B: Soyez sur vos gardes, restez éveillés, car vous ne savez pas quand le moment viendra.
fr.R: Alors faites attention ! Restez éveillés ! Vous ne savez pas quand ce moment viendra.

sw.L: Angalieni, kaeni macho; kwa maana hamjui wakati huo ni lini.
sw.B: Jihadharini na mkae macho, kwa sababu hamjui wakati huo utafika lini.
